The reduced gray-matter density in the pregenual ACC was interpreted as reflecting differences in shape and variability of location rather than reduced ACC volume.

description.value: The anterior cingulate cortex was defined using the segmentation protocol of Tisserand et al. based on the automated ANIMAL segmentation technique.
